title: Replace Figma companion onboarding with English connection controls
description: Make the Figma companion English-only, expose explicit connection states and a persistent connect/disconnect control, reduce instructional clutter, document the Figma auto-start boundary, and verify UI accessibility plus runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: English-only compact companion; explicit loading, connecting, connected, unavailable, and off states; persistent Auto-connect switch; Properties relaunch action; local_loopback transport identity; no hosted Figma MCP fallback; automated runtime, packaging, accessibility, dependency, and full repository gates pass.
notes: Implemented ADR 0008 connection controls and ADR 0009 local transport routing. Verified npm run verify (32/32), axe WCAG scan (0 violations), npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), and packaged Figma artifact.
